intro: Thirigi Vachina is the latest Telugu Christian song written, tuned & sung by Prudhvi Raj featuring Praveen Ritmos and music composed by Johnpaul Reuben. This song was released on November 24, 2024 through Hesed for restoration YouTube channel.
